title: Tender Acceptance Schedule for Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards
content:
Each kind of Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards is accepted as tender on the terms below: the merchandise subtotal the transaction must reach before the card can be redeemed, the purchases the card cannot pay for, whether it is accepted on mfinch.com and in the app, how many cards of that kind one transaction may use, whether a photo ID is required, whether the card can be used together with percent-off promotions, and the fraud hold, in hours after activation, before the card can be redeemed online.

## Acceptance matrix

| Card kind | Minimum merchandise subtotal to redeem | Accepted online (mfinch.com and app) | Cards of this kind per transaction | Photo ID required | Usable with percent-off promotions | Online fraud hold after activation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | $0.00 | Yes | 10 | No | Yes | 24 hours |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | $0.00 | Yes | 10 | No | Yes | 24 hours |
| Merchandise Credit Card | $0.00 | Yes | 10 | No | Yes | 0 hours |
| Registry Reward Card | $0.00 | Yes | 10 | No | Yes | 0 hours |
| Corporate Gift Card | $0.00 | Yes | 10 | No | Yes | 24 hours |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | $50.00 | No | 1 | No | No | 0 hours |

## Purchases each kind cannot pay for

| Card kind | Excluded purchases |
|---|---|
| Marlowe & Finch Gift Card | Gift cards; Marlowe & Finch card payments |
| Marlowe & Finch eGift Card | Gift cards; Marlowe & Finch card payments |
| Merchandise Credit Card | Gift cards; Marlowe & Finch card payments |
| Registry Reward Card | Gift cards; Marlowe & Finch card payments |
| Corporate Gift Card | Gift cards; Marlowe & Finch card payments |
| Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card | Gift cards; Marlowe & Finch card payments; alteration fees; delivery fees; clearance merchandise |

## Notes to the schedule

- The minimum merchandise subtotal is measured on the transaction in which the card is presented. Only the Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card has one ($50.00); for every other kind it is $0.00.
- The fraud hold applies to online redemption only. A Marlowe & Finch Gift Card, a Marlowe & Finch eGift Card or a Corporate Gift Card can be redeemed online from 24 hours after its activation; the other kinds carry a hold of 0 hours.
- The Marlowe & Finch Bonus Card is not accepted online at all, whatever its hold.

### Hypothetical cases at the counter

| Hypothetical transaction | Result on the term tested | Term tested |
|---|---|---|
| Merchandise subtotal $50.00, in store, one Bonus Card | Minimum met | Minimum merchandise subtotal of $50.00, reached exactly |
| Merchandise subtotal $49.99, in store, one Bonus Card | Minimum not met | Minimum merchandise subtotal of $50.00 |
| Two Bonus Cards offered on one in-store transaction | One Bonus Card only | Per-transaction limit of 1 |
| Bonus Card offered on mfinch.com | Not accepted | Not accepted online |

A hypothetical transaction may carry up to 10 Marlowe & Finch Gift Cards and, alongside them, up to 10 Merchandise Credit Cards, since the limit is stated per kind.
